purpose: Restore-mechanics diagnostic only: two fresh uninterrupted A/A controls followed by one first process and one resume of a pinned 2-layer FP32 Llama fixture, using the sealed tokenizer and the unchanged direct-target-device runtime restore path. This protocol cannot claim production full-scope continuation.

fixture.claim_boundary: Fixture restore-mechanics diagnostic only. It cannot establish, convert or replace production MiniCPM5 full-scope exact continuation, and it cannot turn the stopped 381-tensor direct-restore result into passed. No model-quality, throughput or production-resume claim is made.

smoke.resume_checkpoint: one fixture model plus optimizer/RNG/scheduler/cursor checkpoint after update 1
required: checkpoint byte receipt and model/runtime reload
restored scheduler, RNG, optimizer moments and data cursor
resume-start parameter hashes equal the first-process final hashes
all 21 fixture tensors change in each process
native optimizer state step is 2 after resume
first and resume boundary fingerprints are present and exactly equal

aa_envelope.name: aa-envelope-v1
aa_envelope.source: the two fresh uninterrupted arms only

policy.name: aa-envelope-v1
policy.rule: an A/B absolute delta is within the envelope only when it is less than or equal to the largest pairwise A/A delta for the same update and metric from independent uninterrupted arms
requires: at least two uninterrupted arms with identical protocol and implementation
no differing implementation path outside resume-only code
update 1 exactly equal across all arms
first/resume boundary fingerprints exactly equal when present

stop_conditions: any first/resume boundary fingerprint mismatch or missing boundary
any A/A protocol or implementation hash mismatch
any update-1 loss or pre-clip gradient-norm mismatch
direct restore reports nonzero CPU optimizer staging or zero restored bytes

storage_policy.retention: retain exactly one fixture diagnostic checkpoint and all fixture run/failure/comparison reports; no automatic deletion and no promotion

retention.fixture_checkpoint: retain only runs/fused_continuation_fixture_v1/first/resume_checkpoint for inspection; no promotion and no duplicate final model export
retention.historical_evidence: all prior full-scope protocols, run reports, comparison receipts, failure reports and guard logs are immutable evidence
retention.failures: preserve failure reports, profiles and guard logs without relabeling

limitations: This fixture is a restore-mechanics diagnostic, not production MiniCPM5 continuation.
It cannot convert the stopped 381-tensor direct-restore result into a pass.
It makes no model-quality, throughput, promotion or production-resume claim.
Heldout/dev data is not opened; only the pinned diagnostic train rows are used.
Exact hash/logits equality across independent processes is not assumed; the preregistered A/A envelope only labels bounded variation.
